exposure: Transfer from midwife-led to obstetrician-led care
transfer from midwife-led to obstetrician-led care
outcome: Experiences of disrespect and abuse (D&A) during labor and birth
cohort: 11,520 women over 16 years of age who gave birth in the Netherlands between 2015 and 2020
finding: Transfer from midwife-led to obstetrician-led care, giving birth in a hospital, assisted vaginal birth, and unplanned cesarean section were associated with increased odds of experiencing upsetting situations of disrespect and abuse (D&A) during labor and birth for both primiparous and multiparous women.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal birth and unplanned cesarean section were associated with increased odds of experiencing upsetting D&A for both primiparous and multiparous women.
